topic.title: Energy: The Story in Local Energy Saving Initiatives

candidate_instructions: Read all five sections. Answer Questions 1-5. Follow the stated word limits exactly.

sections.heading: The Story
sections.text: A energy project started five years ago. People saw a problem and wanted to help. They worked together to make things better..

sections.heading: How It Works
sections.text: The project works five days each week. It helps many people in the community. Workers and volunteers are there every day..

sections.heading: People's Stories
sections.text: More and more people come each month. The project is now very popular. Everyone says it is a good thing..

sections.heading: Good and Bad
sections.text: Some things are difficult. There is not enough money. We need more helpers. But people still believe in the work..

sections.heading: The Future
sections.text: The project will grow in the future. More services will start. More people will benefit..
